snippet.title: FAIL safe Teaser
snippet.description:
FAIL.safe is a groundbreaking narrative adventure game that redefines player choice and immersion within the genre.

Talk is cheap. Trust is earned. You are stuck on The Destin, a forsaken starship on the brink of oblivion that is controlled by Novah, a sentient AI who holds the key to your survival. Befriend, manipulate, deceive, and persuade your way to freedom in this sci-fi narrative adventure.

Wishlist and download the demo today: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2888220/FAILsafe/ 

#indiegame #mysterygame #scifi
